text:
ana_csm: Heads up — Lumos Support flagged a sudden throughput spike. New use case: real-time multilingual routing + profanity moderation for live chat (EN/ES/FR). 3x QPS over the last 48h, mainly evenings EU region. 

mike_searle: Got it. Any details on model choices or request shapes? Is it many short messages or long conversations?

ana_csm: short chats, high concurrency. They said ~95% of calls are <= 40 tokens response. Using `gpt-like-3.4x` (our open catalog name), with moderation pipeline on each request.

julia_success: Renewal for Lumos is in ~7 months — this could be a great expansion opportunity if we can stabilize. We should capture enablement needs and a pilot proposal. :sparkles:

sanjay_support: I pulled logs and rate metrics. Top patterns: rapid bursts at 18:00-22:00 CET, 60–70 RPS peak, errors spiking to 5% when concurrency crosses ~250. Attach excerpt: 
```
2025-07-20T19:05:12Z POST /v1/generate 200 latency=120ms
2025-07-20T19:05:13Z POST /v1/generate 503 error=backend_overload
2025-07-20T19:05:14Z POST /v1/generate 200 latency=140ms
```

mike_searle: 503s == capacity breakpoint. Short responses means batching can help, but moderation per-request adds cost. Two options: route moderation to async batch (KV cache) or provision Dedicated pods for predictable SLOs.

ana_csm: Lumos wants as-close-to-real-time as possible (<200ms p95). They're nervous about falling back to cheaper models. Also asked about private deployment for compliance but that's a later ask.

eng_oncall: Opening ENG ticket ENG-4321 to investigate autoscaling limits and fallback policies. I'll add logs + traces. cc @mike_searle.

alerts-bot: [infra] EU-west capacity utilization exceeded 78% for gpu-pool-a (1h). See dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dash/gpu-pool-a

julia_success: Action items from CS side — 1) capture Lumos sample traffic and a short demo of their peak window, 2) enable a 2-week Dedicated pilot quote, 3) run an enablement session for their infra/dev team on routing and caching. I'll take 1 & 3.

mike_searle: From eng: we can propose a small Dedicated pod with aggressive autoscale and prefix/KV cache enabled. Need customer consent to change moderation path to a lightweight prefilter to reduce cost. I'll draft a technical note.

sanjay_support: Also recommend short-term mitigations: increase rate-limit quota temporarily, set aggressive retry/backoff in client, and instrument request sampling for quality regression.

ana_csm: Perfect. I'll coordinate a call with Lumos for tomorrow 11:00 CET and share traffic dump beforehand. I'll also add renewal health note to the account (positive upsell signal if pilot succeeds). :thumbsup:

eng_oncall: I'll post updates in ENG-4321 and ping once we have an initial autoscale tweak.

ana_csm: Thanks all — monitoring closely. Will report back after the call. :eyes:
